title: Lehigh Valley Hot Air
specs: Recognized as one of the best commercial hot air balloon companies in Northeast Pennsylvania
Over 10,000 hours of combined commercial ballooning experience
No specific age, weight, or health requirements stated
Each given day we have about a 50/50 chance of flying, As weather conditions must be almost “ideal” in order for the Hot-Air Balloon Launch to take place.
If there is any sign of a potentially non-safe flight conditions, then your launch must be RESCHEDULED.
Depending on flight location, the visibility must be AT LEAST 1 to 3 miles.
Fronts: There must be no fronts in the area for a balloon launch to occur.
But if the front will move through during time of flight, the launch must be canceled.
Thunderstorms: There must be NO thunderstorms within 100 miles of the launch point for a balloon launch to take place.
